faqs.a:
It is the legislative intent of the city council that every person who purchases lodging
               in the city is exercising a taxable privilege. It is also the intent of the city council
               that every person who is engaged in business in the city and who furnishes lodging
               shall collect the tax imposed under this article.
(Code 1981, § 31-102; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002; Ord. No.
4741
, § 4, 9-14-2020)
